recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is recommended unless OO opens a new issue to revise the current Device.status, Device.availabilityStatus, and DeviceAssociation.associationStatus model.
issue_request: FHIR-21235 was a Published OO change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking to separate active/inactive device state from implanted/explanted association state and remove the implication that inactive implanted devices are removed. The final resolution directed Device.operationalStatus and Device.associationStatus backbones with value and reason subelements.
initial_application: No standalone FHIR-21235 commit was found. Historical commit a7f2575daa listed FHIR-21235 as preapplied through FHIR-26309 and added R5-era Device.operationalStatus and Device.associationStatus value/reason rows to the old Device spreadsheet. FHIR-26375 later confirmed in Jira comments that operational and association status already existed.
additional_context: Later final Device decisions changed the current model without reversing the separation intent: FHIR-32557 clarified Device.status as record status and added Device.availabilityStatus; FHIR-36195 revised the operationalStatus design; FHIR-46962 explicitly said operationalStatus and associationStatus no longer exist on Device in R6; FHIR-48532 split DeviceAssociation.status record lifecycle from DeviceAssociation.associationStatus; and FHIR-48713 added abandoned for implanted devices left in the body but no longer in use.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active source keeps Device.status as record status, Device.availabilityStatus as device availability, and DeviceAssociation.associationStatus as the separate surface for implanted/explanted/attached/on/off/standby/defective/abandoned states. Reintroducing old Device.operationalStatus or Device.associationStatus elements would conflict with later R6 decisions.
